orderingAudit.rejectionJustification: Accepted: one clause + linker chunk + other clause + final chunk (1 order). Structurally rejected: final chunk not last, linker not directly after a complete clause, two clauses juxtaposed without a linker, or linker directly before the final chunk (e.g. …ためにつもりです). The clause-swapped order is grammatical but contradicts the context and is the distractor.

The person-swapped order is grammatical but contradicts the context and is the distractor.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank and N3 pattern chunk protected as grammar-target; chunk brackets/letter labels are punctuation.

designNotes: Every option is a full ordering of the same printed chunks; the distractor is the grammatical role-reversed or clause-swapped order that contradicts the context.
Chunk labels are printed in reverse alphabetical order (E…A / D…A), independent of the answer; the answer is option 1 in 18 of 36 exercises.
Each pattern has 4 contexts: 2 where chunk A takes the key role and 2 where chunk B does.
Rejected candidate patterns: ばかりでなく and はもちろん (reversed orders are only pragmatically odd, not false); によって and に違いない (ordering decision would not depend on the N3 pattern).
reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

findings.location: 16 clause-frame explanations (とたん, ようとしたとき, ために, たびに)
findings.claim: Notes said only the keyed order is grammatical, contradicting the set design in which the swapped sentence is grammatical but wrong for the context.
findings.change: All 16 notes now say there are only two grammatical orders and only the keyed one matches the context.

findings.claim: 出ました in 虹が出ました was glossed 'took part'.
出る in 店を出る was glossed 'take part'.
findings.change: The item was replaced by cake-strawberry (see SCI-B-02).

findings.claim: 'Reverses the context' overclaimed: the reversed habit was unmentioned rather than contradicted.
findings.change: Each たびに context gained one sentence that makes the reversed habit false, and the rationales quote it; mother-calls was tightened in round 3 (see SCI-B-01).

reviews.finalVerdict: CLEAN with recorded disagreement after three rounds: the reviewer retains a template-diversity concern on SCI-B-02, closed by coordinator decision
